description.narrative: Establishement of a facility to involve the Swedish Somali diaspora in support of the development of Somalia
Etablering och drift av en facilitet som ska stödja den svensk somaliska diasporan i att bidra till utvecklingen i Somalia.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2014Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The 19 projects implemented with support from the programme have contributed to the following: - Increased active participation of the Somali Diaspora in development in Somalia through transfer of knowledge, capacity building of local organisations and empowerment of the poor from a rights-based perspective.
Specifically the projects have contributed to:
1) Improved health service delivery through improved capacity building of health workers, reorganisation of health professionals, introduction of new and simple technologies in hospitals and increased reach out to children under five, FGM traumatized girls and women, pregnant women and people with severe mental disorders. 2) Women were empowered through capacity building in business development and entrepreneurship and increased awareness of the Somali society about women rights. The programme contributed to increased awareness on active and effective participation of the female MPs at all levels in the Somali federal parliament. 3) The process of creating a sustainable peace, reconciliation and security by providing forums for dialogue and discussions between clan leader, youth, women, civil society organizations and the Diaspora. New approaches were introduced for conflict management, promotion of nonviolence culture and increased employment 4) Increased awareness on environmental protection and introduction of new workable ideas that focus on increase awareness of the target group on environmental issues. An extensive awareness raising campaign was implemented using local media and other communication channels.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
